summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 6, 2026 press release announcing that its DefendAir net-based interception technology will be paired with ThirdEye Systems' newly unveiled Iron Web drone-detection layer for armored vehicles. The disclosure follows the companies' September 15, 2026 non-binding memorandum of understanding covering a 360 degree detect-to-defeat counter-UAS architecture. No financial terms, equity stake, price per share, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock were stated. DefendAir and Iron Web will be showcased at the AUSA Annual Meeting, October 12-14, 2026, Booth 739. Watch for conversion of the MOU into definitive commercialization agreements.
